subject: per-vt-u-fund
title: (R)PER.VT.U.FUND.------WO.EXT.PRIN.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-29 (Social Reality / Trans-Information, Level Two) accompanying Braxton's claim: 'the physical universe reality situation of a given people or culture dictates what aspect of their information is to be relevant or utilized — which is to say, it would be counter-productive to over-generalize this most important subject.' (R)PER-VT-U-FUND (the reality of perceived vibrational-universe fundamental) is crossed with WO-EXT-PRIN: the question is what perceived-vibrational-universe-fundamental produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with WO-EXT-PRIN — the (R) prefix marking real perception is at stake. WO-EXT-PRIN itself is partner. PRI-AF-TD (primary affinity tendencies) branches from the main line and carries EXT-FT (extended functionalism). SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics) also branches from the main line and carries POST (postulation) and RIT-DYM (ritual dynamics). RIT-DYM carries V-SY (value system), which carries ROTP (responsibility of the position), and TR-DEF (trans-definition), which carries AFL (affinity alignment); LANG-DY (language dynamics) branches from AFL.
